caption: The drawing features three renditions of a circular object, likely a locket or compact, set against a beige background. Each object appears to have a thick, gold-colored, circular frame with a beaded inner edge. The left object displays a symmetrical, urn-like vessel with a red lid, blue finial, green garlands, and pink handles, standing on a greenish pedestal, centered within the round frame. The center object is shown in a side view, illustrating the thickness and hinge mechanism of the gold frame, with a dashed arc suggesting its ability to open. The right object shows another view of the urn motif, with a red finial, blue decorative elements on either side, and green garlands, also centered inside the gold frame. Each circular frame encloses a white or pale background to highlight the central urn designs. In the bottom right corner of the beige background, the name “JANET RIZA” is written in uppercase letters, and in the bottom left, there is a scale in inches. The drawing is bordered by a rectangular outline close to the paper’s edge.
title: Drawer Pull
